title: Single Cell Isolation and Monoclonal Culture of Acanthamoeba castellanii
author: Morgan Colp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc3eiyje

steps.title: Prepare E. coli Feed
steps.instruction: Prepare a heat-killed E. coli K-12 suspension for the agar plates.

substeps.instruction: Grow a 24 hour culture of E. coli K-12 in LB.
Pellet the E. coli and resuspend in an equal volume of water or Page's Amoeba Saline in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Heat-kill the E. coli in a 65 degree C water bath for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare PAS Agar Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare and seed PAS agar plates with heat-killed E. coli.

substeps.instruction: Pour PAS agar into 3 to 5 Petri plates per 10 cells planned for isolation and let set.
Spread 1 mL aliquots of heat-killed E. coli onto each plate, continuing to spread until dry.

steps.title: Inoculate Plates with Acanthamoeba
steps.instruction: Seed the prepared plates with Acanthamoeba castellanii cells.

substeps.instruction: Scrape the internal surface of a 7 to 14 day old Acanthamoeba castellanii liquid culture and gently shake the flask to suspend cells.
Pipette 1 microlitre of the Acanthamoeba suspension into the centre of each plate.

steps.title: Monitor Cell Migration
steps.instruction: Allow cells to migrate and verify dispersion using an inverted microscope.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 3 to 5 days until cells have migrated far enough from the centre that the furthest ones are 1 cm or more apart.
Use an inverted microscope to confirm dispersion, looking for visible trails through the bacterial lawn.

steps.title: Isolate Single Cells
steps.instruction: Physically isolate single cells into a multi-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Cut 1 cm squares out of the agar, each containing only one cell (verified by inverted microscope).
Place one square into each well of a 12 well culture plate.
Optionally, cut squares from the middle of the plate into a few wells to serve as positive controls.

steps.title: Establish Monoclonal Cultures
steps.instruction: Grow the isolated cells in PYG medium and transfer to flasks.

substeps.instruction: Add enough PYG medium to fully cover the agar cubes (wells can be fully filled).
Allow growth at room temperature, monitoring via inverted microscope.
Optionally add 10 ug/ml polymyxin B to control bacterial growth.
Once cells cover the entire bottom of a well (similar to 4-5 days growth in regular culture), scrape the wells and transfer the contents into flasks for growth in typical culture conditions.
If isolating single transformed cells, select immediately or wait a few days for monoclonal populations to establish in flasks.
